description: Get precomputed AI intraday news recap buckets from the database. Use this when the user asks for intraday news analysis, same-day market narrative, what happened during the trading day, or a specific recap bucket. If bucketId is provided, this returns exactly that bucket. Otherwise it returns all buckets for date, ordered chronologically. If neither date nor bucketId is provided, it automatically returns the latest date that has intraday recap data, so the AI does not need to ask the user for a date first. Returned fields include bucket time window in US Eastern Time, source/news counts, headline, market narrative, and affected tickers. This is read-only and never triggers new AI analysis.

bucketId.description: Exact intraday bucket id returned by list_news_recaps, e.g. 2026-05-12T14:30ET. Use this for a single bucket.

date.description: US Eastern calendar date to fetch, e.g. 2026-05-12. Omit to use the latest date with intraday data. Ignored when bucketId is provided.

limit.description: Maximum buckets to return when bucketId is omitted (1-20). Default: 10.

offset.description: Bucket pagination offset for the selected date (0-100). Default: 0.

name: get_intraday_news_recaps
